title: Jesus... I Liked His Photo With Her 💔
topic: her ex posted a photo with his new girlfriend and she liked it so he would think she is fine

bible.text: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... he posted a photo with her today. I liked it so he'd think I'm fine. 💔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Two years together. Three months apart. One tap, and I looked okay.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You weren't liking a photo. You were hiding a wound.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone says I should have moved on by now.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Healing isn't pretending it doesn't hurt. It's letting Me near the part that does.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't have to look fine tonight. Just be honest with Me.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who's "fine" after a breakup. 💌
